games.title: Games
games.description: Which games to fetch. Empty = all supported games.

sinceDays.title: Draws from the last N days
sinceDays.description: How far back to fetch. Set large (e.g. 15000) for the full history of a game.

maxRows.title: Max draws per run
maxRows.description: Cap on draw rows returned, split across the selected games. Controls total cost.

dedupe.title: Skip draws seen in previous runs
dedupe.description: Remember returned draws across runs and skip them. Turn on with a daily schedule for a hands-free new-results feed.
